tools.name: SifuExport (sifuexport/, C# on CUE4Parse)

runtime_boundary: Game build 18739835 (v_1.29_6.775), pak in Sifu/Content/Paks/~mods with the game's own .sig. The user confirmed Karin Original v6 in game (skirt proxy 11 x 32 rings, solver 240 Hz); earlier agent captures cover title screen, Wuguan garden walk, blink, bone-chain physics settle. The four variants (opt, pt, umb, y) v1 were checked offline only (preview sheets, face poses, cooked-mesh references read back with CUE4Parse); none was run in game. The portable copies were checked offline only: the Blender build of karin_original and y, the y AO / textures / ue_build.json and package_release reproduce the project outputs (see VALIDATION.md); the UE-side scripts, PowerShell tools, plugin and SifuExport were reviewed, not re-run.
python: 3.10+ (standard library) for dyn_tuning.py and package_release.py; make_textures.py needs numpy 2.5 (3.12+) and Pillow, frames_to_gif.py needs Pillow; Blender scripts run in Blender's Python 3.11; tested 3.14.0
dependency_install: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r portable-kits/sifu/requirements.txt (from bundle root; only needed for make_textures.py and frames_to_gif.py)
